text: Official and unique reference assigned by the official central body/ entity within each market at the beginning of a meeting event.
Reference assigned by the account servicer to unambiguously identify a related meeting event.
Identifies the additional right code.
This code can be used in case another reason is required.
Additional right granted to specify the minimum stake in share capital or cash value or number of security holders required to table resolutions.
Additional right granted to specify the minimum stake in share capital or cash value or number of security holders required to table resolutions. This minimum is expressed as a percentage.
Proxy assignment and registration information.
Indicates that no proxy is allowed for a meeting.
Date expressed as a calendar date.
Specifies the type of date.
Standard code to specify the type of date.
Proprietary identification of the type of date.
Specifies physical address of the meeting.
Indicates that the location is unknown.
Minimum quantity of securities required to hold a meeting.
Minimum quantity of securities, expressed as a percentage, required to hold a meeting.
Number of votes assigned to one security.
Specifies the calculation method of the number of votes assigned to one security. This element should be used when the entitlement calculation rule is complex.
Threshold provided as a percentage rate.
Threshold provided as a decimal number.
Nature of the quantity used as a basis to set a threshold for voting on resolutions at general meetings and provided as a code value.
Nature of the quantity used as a basis to set a threshold for voting on resolutions at general meetings and defined as a proprietary value.
